description:
Ship the two licence texts so the distribution carries them, and try to make the
repository page show a licence badge instead of "View license".

=== DONE (s481a), with one part deliberately NOT done ===

LICENSE-Artistic and LICENSE-GPL are perl 5.40.3's "Artistic" and "Copying",
copied byte-for-byte (md5 71a4d5d9acc18c0952a6df2218bb68da and
5b122a36d0f6dc55279a0ebc69f3c60b, verified against the originals).  LICENSE
keeps the dual statement every source header points at and now names the two
files instead of telling the reader to fetch them.  README's License section and
docs/pcl-commands.md name them; README also says cl/vendor/ is third-party under
its own terms.  Neither text is tagged: PCLLicense's root scan only takes *.pl
and extensionless files WITH a shebang, so they are not code files and an
EXCLUDE entry would have been a lie (the gate requires every named exclusion to
be MET by the scan).

THE BADGE WAS NOT OBTAINED.  Measured, not guessed:

    $ curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Percolisp/pcl/license
    "name": "LICENSE", ... "spdx_id": "NOASSERTION"

GitHub names LICENSE as the file it read, so the detector matches the TEXT of
the root LICENSE file; sibling files cannot change that verdict.  A badge means
replacing that file's content with one licence's verbatim text, which is a
change to the project's licensing STATEMENT rather than its packaging -- the
owner's call, and one whose outcome is only observable after a push.

REMEDY, on the USER checklist (session-log s481a, item 4): `git mv LICENSE
COPYRIGHT` + `cp LICENSE-Artistic LICENSE`, then re-check with the curl above,
changing ONE thing at a time -- GitHub reports "other" when it finds more than
one distinct matched licence in the root, so LICENSE-GPL may then have to move
out of the root (the text still ships; the detector just stops seeing two).
subject: P3: LICENSE-Artistic + LICENSE-GPL ship beside LICENSE (verbatim from perl 5.40.3).  The GitHub license BADGE was NOT obtained -- measured why, and the remedy is the owner's call
